name: onboarding-01
title: Onboarding 01 - A Setup Checklist Or A Rail Of The Order
description: A setup checklist: a set of steps each with a state, an optional action, and a progress figure whose sentence is the caller's, plus a completion note the caller writes. A blocked step is first class, because a checklist that cannot say a reader is stuck will read as broken. The steps form composes the rail and the checklist form draws the marks, and a client Component because onSelect is a handler.
